# KIDO 2628 Retail App - Desktop POS & Inventory

> Modern, production-grade, offline-first Desktop POS & Inventory Management system for children's fashion retail, built with Electron, TypeScript, React 18, Tailwind CSS, and local SQLite with ACID transactions.

## Architecture & Core Tech Stack
- Desktop Runtime: Electron v33 (LTS) with electron-vite
- Core Language: TypeScript (strict mode enabled across all targets)
- Persistence Layer: Embedded SQLite using better-sqlite3 with WAL mode, foreign keys, and synchronous normal
- Inter-Process Communication: Strongly typed context bridge with Main-process Zod validation
- User Interface: React 18, Tailwind CSS v3, Lucide React icons, Zustand state stores
- Hardware Engines: Silent ESC/POS 72mm/80mm thermal receipt printing, SVG Code-128 63x34mm barcode label printing, <60ms burst hardware scanner listener

## Developer & Verification Commands
- Test Suite: npm test (runs 12-suite domain verification under Electron runtime)
- Typecheck: npm run typecheck (validates both tsconfig.node.json and tsconfig.web.json)
- Bundle Build: npm run build (electron-vite production bundle)
- Windows Packaging: npm run build:win (NSIS and Portable .exe)
- macOS Packaging: npm run build:mac (.dmg and unpacked .app)
